people.name: Wei Rao / A Chou
people.note: Raised in poverty as a night-soil collector; unknowingly the Wei family's true-born daughter, she marries Lu Zhuo in Jun Dai's place.

people.name: Lu Zhuo / Shou Cheng
people.note: Heir of the Duke of Ying's household, gravely wounded by a poisoned arrow before the marriage.

people.name: Jun Dai
people.note: The household's false young miss, who schemed to avoid marrying the dying Lu Zhuo by having A Chou take her place.

people.name: Qi Zhong Kai
people.note: Marquis of Pingxi's second son and Lu Zhuo's trusted comrade.

people.name: Bi Tao
people.note: A Chou's devoted maid, originally planted as Guo Yufeng's spy.

people.name: Han Liao
people.note: Heir of the Marquis of Xiting's household.

people.name: Rong De
people.note: Lu Zhuo's personal attendant, known as Jiede.

people.name: Guo Yu Feng
people.note: Old Madam Wei's eldest daughter-in-law, suspected of arranging the original baby swap.

people.name: Old Madam Wei
people.note: Matriarch of the Cheng'an Earl's household, unknowingly A Chou's biological grandmother.

people.name: Wei Heng'e
people.note: Old Madam Wei's daughter, who masterminds the substitute marriage.

people.name: Wei Chan
people.note: Old Madam Wei's third granddaughter, resentful of favoritism toward her cousin.

people.name: Zhao Fu
people.note: Wei Rao's birth mother.

people.name: Shou An Jun
people.note: Wei Rao's maternal grandmother, a former imperial wet nurse.

people.name: Hong Xian
people.note: A maid who helps A Chou's adoptive mother escape.

people.name: Duke Ying
people.note: Lu Zhuo's grandfather, head of the Duke of Ying's household.

people.name: Duchess Ying
people.note: Lu Zhuo's grandmother, who forces the marriage to save his life.

people.name: Xie Hua Lou
people.note: The Grand Tutor's granddaughter, assaulted by Jun Dai out of jealousy.

people.name: Empress Dowager
people.note: Issues the edict forcing the marriage to proceed.

people.name: A Chou's adoptive mother
people.note: Chronically ill; her illness and medical costs push A Chou into the substitute marriage.

people.name: A Chou's adoptive father
people.note: A gambler who sells A Chou to settle a debt; later strangled after his wife's escape.

links.label: An arranged marriage made amid a death sentence and a dying fiancé becomes her new life.
links.evidence: Wei Rao steps in to secure funds for her adoptive mother's medical treatment, entering a marriage neither expected.

links.label: Real feelings grow between them as Lu Zhuo comes to trust and care for the wife who saved his nephew.
links.evidence: In private, Lu Zhuo admits that he wrongly accused her and thanks her for saving Lu Che.

links.label: The false daughter and the true heiress are locked in fierce rivalry, the story's 'twin black lotus' conflict.
links.evidence: 与魏娆形成"并蒂黑莲"的激烈对抗

links.label: Jun Dai was Lu Zhuo's childhood fiancée before arranging A Chou's substitution.
links.evidence: she notices her childhood fiancé, Lu Zhuo, speaking with Xie Hualou.

links.label: Lu Zhuo recognizes her faked injury and resolves to end their betrothal.
links.evidence: He explains that his battlefield experience has taught him to distinguish an inflicted wound from one deliberately made on oneself... he intends to formally end their engagement.

links.label: In a jealous rage, Jun Dai pushes Xie Hua Lou from a height, nearly killing her.
links.evidence: Declaring that her engagement gives her an exclusive claim over Lu Zhuo, she accuses Xie of trying to steal him and pushes her from the pavilion.

links.label: Lu Zhuo saves Xie Hua Lou from the fall, witnessing Jun Dai's violence.
links.evidence: Lu Zhuo catches Xie before she hits the ground.

links.label: Wei Heng'e is Jun Dai's aunt and co-conspirator in the bride substitution.
links.evidence: Wei Heng'e sends her niece to a hot-spring residence and orders her to abandon the name Rao. She gives her the new name Jun Dai, which Rao accepts.

links.label: Wei Heng'e secures A Chou as a substitute bride to spare the real Wei Rao the match.
links.evidence: Wei Heng'e argues that the Lu household is already weakened by deaths and disability among its men... Wei Heng'e promises lifelong comfort if she succeeds.

links.label: Old Madam Wei is unknowingly A Chou's true biological grandmother, the real heiress of the Wei household.
links.evidence: 魏老夫人四孫女，承安伯府真千金

links.label: Guo Yufeng is Old Madam Wei's eldest daughter-in-law.
links.evidence: 魏老夫人大兒媳。

links.label: Guo Yufeng's old order to Governess Chang, and the remains it uncovers, hint she orchestrated the switch that erased the true heiress years ago.
links.evidence: Guo goes to Governess Chang's quarters and orders a search. Chou's resemblance to Rao has made her question whether Chang truly obeyed an instruction given years earlier.

links.label: Bi Tao was originally planted in the household as Guo Yufeng's informant.
links.evidence: 承安伯府婢女，原是魏大夫人眼線。

links.label: Bi Tao becomes fiercely loyal to A Chou, eventually killing to protect her.
links.evidence: A Chou asks Bitao to describe the dowry in detail.

links.label: Bi Tao switches a poisoned soup meant for A Chou, unintentionally killing the spy Governess Wu.
links.evidence: Bitao confesses that she saw Wu tampering with the soup and switched it, intending only to make her suffer the consequences. She never expected the dose to be fatal.

links.label: Wei Chan is Jun Dai's cousin, resentful of the favoritism shown to her.
links.evidence: Wei Chan resents the attention lavished on her younger cousin and openly complains about the family's favoritism.

links.label: Chan taunts Jun Dai about her impending widowhood and insults her mother, and the two come to blows.
links.evidence: Rao attacks her.

links.label: Old Madam Wei is Wei Chan's grandmother.
links.evidence: 魏老夫人三孫女。

links.label: Duke Ying is Lu Zhuo's grandfather.
links.evidence: 陸濯祖父。

links.label: Duchess Ying is Lu Zhuo's grandmother.
links.evidence: 陸濯祖母，特邀出演。

links.label: The duchess credits the marriage with saving her grandson and comes to cherish the bride she believes is Wei Rao.
links.evidence: Lu Zhuo's grandmother credits the marriage with saving him. She thanks the woman she believes is Wei Rao for marrying him when recovery seemed impossible and promises to remember her kindness.

links.label: An edict from the Empress Dowager leaves the Wei family unable to refuse the marriage.
links.evidence: An imperial attendant soon arrives with an edict from the Empress Dowager, leaving the Wei family unable to reject the marriage.

links.label: A trusted fellow officer and friend from the battlefield.
links.evidence: He orders his attendant Jiede to close the garden to guests and asks Qi Zhongkai, the Marquis of Pingxi's second son, to fetch the Grand Princess.

links.label: Lu Zhuo suspects a leak behind the deadly ambush and sets a trap using Qi Zhongkai to test loyalty.
links.evidence: Lu Zhuo suspects that someone leaked the plans for his surprise attack to the enemy. Qi resists the accusation... Lu Zhuo proposes a test.

links.label: Jiede is Lu Zhuo's personal attendant.
links.evidence: He orders his attendant Jiede to close the garden to guests.

links.label: A Chou supports her sickly adoptive mother, whose medical costs push her into the substitute marriage.
links.evidence: Wei Rao steps in to secure funds for her adoptive mother's medical treatment.

links.label: Her gambling-addicted adoptive father sold her to settle a debt.
links.evidence: he sells Chou to a gambling-den owner and lets the man into her room while she is bedridden with a fever.

links.label: To settle a 300-coin debt, her father sells her to a gambling-den owner, who then assaults her.
links.evidence: To settle a debt of three hundred coins, he sells Chou to a gambling-den owner and lets the man into her room while she is bedridden with a fever.

links.label: Hong Xian helps A Chou's mother escape with her younger siblings.
links.evidence: She escapes with Hongxian and Runsheng.

links.label: Lady Shou'an is Wei Rao's maternal grandmother, a former imperial wet nurse.
links.evidence: 魏娆外祖母，曾任陛下乳母，特邀出演。

links.label: Zhao Fu is Wei Rao's birth mother.
links.evidence: 魏娆生母，特邀主演。
